title: A first run-of-river hydropower plant development in a permafrost-rich subarctic Canadian region: short-term fate of mercury and carbon
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,3572-3585
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00171D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mariane St-Aubin, Jean-François Lapierre, Dominic E. Ponton, Michel Sliger, Jeanne Gaudreault, Éric Atagotaaluk, Daniel Fortier, Marc Amyot
Minimal research exists on the environmental impact of hydroelectricity in permafrost areas. This study reports increases in methylmercury in flooded soils, surface waters and first trophic levels following impoundment.
